primary_meaning: A christological title for Jesus as the reliable, true, and ultimate revealer/testifier of God's character, will, and truth (even unto death)
primary_basis: John 18:37 (linked as background for Jesus' self-description as witness to the truth)

alternatives.meaning: A designation for Christian martyrs who faithfully testify to Christ even unto death (by analogy with the martys root)
The moon (or creation) as a reliable celestial/covenantal witness

notes: In published Christian interpretation and biblical studies the capitalized or titular form is overwhelmingly treated as a Revelation christological title; secondary applications to martyrs or Old Testament imagery exist but do not displace the primary sense.
